title: The Random Stuff I thought would be cool in minecraft mod
description: A mod adding custom weapons mobs and more!
body:
a mod adding new mobs, weapons, bosses, biomes, armor sets and more!
this is my first time making a mod!
adding mobs like the void cultist which gives status effects on hit and drops a sword which does the same thing! enchantments like shadow which deal more damage over time and can scale depending on level! 
full mobs: voidling, endermage, voidcultist, voidslime, starsentry, endermancer, enderitegolem guardianofthedepths crab magmaghast voidghast swampmonster shadowwalker
